title: Critical email from a customer got quarantined
description: The customer said they sent a contract file, but it's not in my inbox, it may have been quarantined.

worklogs.description: Found the email in the Mimecast quarantine interface and released it.
Added the sender to the 'permitted senders' list.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: We released the email to your inbox and added the sender to the safe list. Please take another look.

resolutionNote: Email was released from Mimecast quarantine, sender domain added to the whitelist. User confirmed receipt.
